limits: Local pgvector 0.8.6; staging snapshot used 0.8.2 and local ANN indexes were rebuilt. This is not proof of identical PostgreSQL plans or rankings.
The exact seven-case replay uses the accepted full-engine companion. It does not reconstruct missing original September 1 provider calls.
Core #245 reuses the completed same-day legacy #243 witness on the same clone. Runs overlap partly; timings are observations, not performance benchmarks.
Per-corpus judge rates have small denominators and remain diagnostic; frozen global drops are limited to 0.05 for judge pass rate and document recall.

Legacy evaluation character-based Albert token estimates are excluded. Trace usage covers reported successful LLM calls; failed-call, embedding and reranking usage and complete cost remain incomplete.
Detailed gold questions, answers, contexts and trace payloads remain in private local artifacts. No historical user conversations were imported.
